messages:
Maya: Quick follow-up to the auth RFC. Proposal: standardize on a project-scoped API key format where the signed claim contains project_id + compact role_mask. Keeps hot-path checks O(1).
Alex: How do we support cross-project pipelines and admin tools that currently use org-scoped keys?
Maya: Introduce a 'proxy umbrella' token flow: umbrella token is org-anchored but can mint short-lived project sub-tokens via a constrained exchange endpoint. Minted tokens are scoped, audited, and ephemeral.
Priya: Migration concern: we have many long-lived org keys. We need a compatibility plan that doesn't break running services.
Sam: Can we have a transform shim at the ingress layer that accepts old org-keys and emits equivalent project-scoped claims (shadow-logged) while owners migrate?
Maya: Yes. Plan: run shim in passthrough + shadow mode for 30 days, surface migration warnings, then enable strict enforcement. No silent rejections.
Alex: For umbrella minting limits: enforce TTL <= 5m for sub-tokens, per-umbrella rate-limit (e.g., 10/min), and max active sub-tokens (e.g., 50) to bound blast radius.
Priya: Also require umbrella tokens to have an explicit audit_id claim and origin_tag so we can trace which pipeline minted which sub-token.
Sam: Introspection API prototype shape (keep tiny):

```
token=xyz123
claims.project=proj-42
claims.role_mask=0x12
claims.origin=umbrella:org-7
exp=1710000500
```

The runtime should read role_mask and do a single bitmask check. No extra DB call.
Maya: Telemetry: emit structured audit line for every mint and critical deny. Fields: actor, token_kind, umbrella_id, project, role_mask, action, outcome, request_id. We'll use this for post-mortems and migration metrics.
Alex: Implementation: make origin_project and role_mask part of the signed JWT so enforcement is stateless. Policy deltas can be pushed via a small in-memory cache keyed by project.
Priya: Perf note: prefer compact binary mask encoded as hex string in claim to avoid JSON parsing overhead on hot paths.
Sam: Pseudocode check: if ((hexToMask(claims.role_mask) & REQ_INGEST) != 0) allow; else deny.
Maya: Action items: Priya+Alex draft shim + minting policy, Sam finalize claim encoding, Platform define audit schema, Eng owners pick 2 services for canary. Sync in 48h.
Alex: Also: add migration FAQ and sample curl commands for customers to exchange org keys for umbrella tokens during transition.
Priya: I'll draft the FAQ and a short ops playbook. :thumbsup:
AuthBot: RFC link posted: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/authn-token-shift-v2 (auto). Issue created INF-3337 for rollout tracking (auto).
